name: The Holy Blissful Martyr Saint Thomas of Canterbury
name_pt: O Santo Bem-aventurado Mártir São Tomás de Cantuária
desc: Benson's short life of St Thomas Becket (1910) for the Westminster Library: his birth, youth and rise, the chancellor and archbishop, the troubles in England, exile and return, and his passion, death and coronation in glory.
desc_pt: A breve vida de São Tomás Becket por Benson (1910), para a Westminster Library: nascimento, juventude e ascensão, o chanceler e arcebispo, os problemas na Inglaterra, o exílio e o regresso, e sua paixão, morte e coroação na glória.
edition: The Holy Blissful Martyr Saint Thomas of Canterbury (London: Sands & Co., 1910), Internet Archive full-text OCR (holyblissfulmart00bensuoft).
